slides.headline: Using AI is easy. *Building* with it is engineering.

slides.heading: What is *AI engineering*?
body: Making AI models work inside real products.
Reliable, useful, and safe for users.

slides.heading: It's *applied* AI, not research.
body: Engineers use models to solve real problems.

slides.heading: Start with *one* small build.
body: Pick a task you do every week.
Automate it with an API call.

slides.headline: Learn by building, one small system at a time.
slides.cta: What would you automate first? Tell me below.
